subject: general
question: ________ in Punjab was earlier known as Ramdaspur.
solution:
The correct answer is **Amritsar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amritsar** was originally known as **Ramdaspur**.
 
• It was founded by the fourth Sikh Guru, **Guru Ram Das**, in 1577.
 
• The city is home to the **Harmandir Sahib**, also known as the **Golden Temple**, which is the holiest Gurdwara of Sikhism.
 
• Amritsar is a major cultural and religious center in the state of **Punjab**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Feature
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Harmandir Sahib**
 The holiest Gurdwara of Sikhism, also known as the **Golden Temple**.
 
 

 **Jallianwala Bagh**
 A public garden in Amritsar, which houses a memorial of national importance established in 1951 to commemorate the massacre of peaceful celebrators by British forces on April 13, 1919.
 
 

 **Wagah Border**
 The ceremonial border line between India and Pakistan, known for its daily military parade.
 
 

 **Partition Museum**
 A museum in Amritsar that focuses on the stories and memories of the partition of India in 1947.
